'''R2-C4''', or "'''Seefor'''", was a yellow [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].

==Biography==
[[File:Lt._Gavyn_Sykes_-_Bravo_6_-_Christian_Simpson.jpg|thumb|left|100px|R2-C4 with Sykes.]]
[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|royal starship]] held a complement of droids, one of which was R2-C4.<ref name="SWI94">{{InsiderCite|94|Set Piece|Set Piece: Naboo Royal Starship}}</ref> During Amidala's escape from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], R2-C4 was tasked with repairing the [[Naboo Royal Starship/Legends|Naboo Royal Starship]]'s starboard [[Engine/Legends|engine]], while the other [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] repaired its [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] and were almost entirely destroyed,<ref name="S&V 62 Did You Know">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|62|Did You Know?}}</ref> save for [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], this droid was present in the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] with a member of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]], Lt. [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] ([[Bravo Six/Legends|Bravo 6]]) prior to the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle.<ref name="TPM" /> Both survived the engagement.<ref name="S&V 62 Did You Know" />
